# FalaAI API - Java SDK

> Official Java SDK for the FalaAI API - AI-powered call transcription (speech-to-text), conversation diagnostics, and compliance/risk auditing.

## Links
- Documentation: https://actiontecbr.github.io/falaai-api-java/
- Repository: https://github.com/ActionTecBr/falaai-api-java
- Package (Maven Central): https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/io.github.actiontecbr/falaai-api
- OpenAPI contract: https://api01-falaai.action.tec.br/openapi.json
- Platform: https://falaai.action.tec.br/api

## Endpoints
- POST /v1/audio/transcriptions - transcribe a call (audio to text)
- POST /v1/analyze/diagnostic - conversation diagnosis
- POST /v1/analyze/riskAudit - compliance / risk audit
- GET /v1/health - health check
